cascaded.description: Set by run_cascades once the invalidation cascade for this refuted assumption has actually run. Distinguishes 'refuted, cascade pending' from 'refuted and cascaded' -- the two are indistinguishable from `status` alone, and a crash between apply_verify's refute and run_cascades otherwise loses the cascade on recovery. apply_verify refutes without setting this; run_cascades cascades a refuted assumption only when it is not yet set, and sets it to true on completion, so re-applying after a completed cascade stays a no-op. Optional: absent means false, which keeps plan 1's pre-Task-12 assumption samples valid.
